FrozenQualificationBinary.Limit: The focused and review packet recorded the pre-commit assembly hash. The final source commit is unchanged from the reviewed head; a rebuild embeds that commit in informational version and SourceLink. Exact final core bytes are matched between the full test host and comparison host. No assertion of byte identity with the earlier focused binary.

ChangedDecoders: Stacked DataBar image recognition locates two normalized physical data rows in both image axes and line directions, validates their assembled payload through the existing checksum and character decoder, and checks the intervening separator against canonical encoder layouts. It accepts Stacked and Stacked Omnidirectional with inversion and right-angle rotation, returning one symbol.

Collection samples at most 256 lines per axis and retains at most 64 observations per row role and direction. Assembly considers at most 4096 pairs, with geometry and polarity checks before checksum and separator validation. Cancellation and monotonic deadlines are checked during scanning and pairing; pooled luminance storage is returned on all exits. One shared scanner attempt serves both stacked variants.

RSS-14 comparison input IDs, bytes, oracles and scoring stay fixed. CodeGlyphX now receives all four RSS-14 physical variants, matching the family hint in both comparison readers. The previous qualified core still decodes 4/12 with this broader hint. No public overload or production dependency is added.

Stacked DataBar pixels and single-row height classification share the existing alpha-aware scanner luminance helper. Fully transparent RGB is composited against white; partially transparent visible bars retain recognition. The sibling classifier repair fixes hidden-RGB height inflation without changing opaque-pixel classification.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 198/267 correct positive images versus 195/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: none; gained: rss14-1/5.png, rss14-1/2.png, rss14-2/24.png. Paired negative completion is [30, 29, 30, 30]/31 with the current binary and [30, 29, 30, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. Stacked DataBar adds one shared default scanner attempt for its two variants within the existing total allowance. RSS-14 hint scope changes the work requested in that family, so timing changes do not isolate decoder implementation cost. Demonstrated regression gains do not establish accuracy on unseen photographs. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Stacked DataBar and Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported.

RegressionProof.Coverage: Both canonical stacked layouts across all quarter-turn rotations and polarities; exact payload and GS1 identity; wrong physical-layout rejection; three unmodified independent encoded images through explicit and default requests; unrelated row rejection; missing separator rejection; monotonic deadline, cancellation and a subsequent successful decode. Alpha-zero stacked patterns are rejected, alpha96 remains readable, and transparent RGB extensions cannot inflate linear DataBar height.
RegressionProof.ComparisonHintChanged: RSS-14 uses all four CodeGlyphX physical variants to match the comparison readers broad family hint. A same-adapter previous-core pass retains 4/12.
RegressionProof.FocusedTestSetupCorrection: The initial independent photograph assertion assumed Stacked Omnidirectional identity, although the upstream oracle specifies only an RSS-14 payload. The final test asserts exact payload and family plus consistency between explicit/default requests; synthetic separator tests retain exact physical identity and wrong-layout rejection.

Host.Purpose: Current contract test against the immutable pre-fix core; expect Truncated identity versus incorrect Omnidirectional.

AlphaRegressionBeforeFix.Limit: Expected failures against the immutable rejected first candidate; the first sibling setup outside selected scanlines is retained separately and is not defect proof.

RegressionProof.HistoricalProof: Earlier decoder qualification remains historical in previous-qualification.json and its retained archive. Current full suites and frozen/supplemental outcomes are rerun.

TestExecution.Net472: Task-local runner configuration disables collection parallelism; recognition allowances and assertions are unchanged.
TestExecution.Limit: Short wall-clock allowances remain sensitive to shared-host load. Serial legacy qualification is not proof for default parallel execution.
